pairs.difference: A: the backboard's thick right edge falls into a clean darker plane against a pale lit face, and the pole turns gradually from light to dark. B: the blue sphere is lit from the front with a broad milky glow and a pale rim all round. It has almost no core shadow, and in the lens it washes out to a soft lilac ball, with the lower form contrast of the pair (0.388 against 0.493).
pairs.fix: Light the sphere from the upper left only. Let its lower right fall into a deep, darker blue shadow band, with one small soft highlight. Remove the glowing edge around the sphere.

pairs.difference: A: the ring box has a directional light: a pale top rim, a darker lower front, and the lid's outer face turning into shadow, with cool shadows in the lens. B: both tanks carry the same centred vertical highlight and darken about equally on both sides. The light is frontal and symmetrical, and the lens reads warm brown throughout.
pairs.fix: Light the tanks from one side so the left tank is brighter than the right. Put a dark shadow where the tanks meet, make the shadow side cool, and use a single streak highlight on the lit edge of each tank.

pairs.difference: A: the dome and drum are brightest in the centre and darken about equally toward both edges, with a pale halo around the dome in the lens, so no clear shadow side exists. B: the motel's light comes from its practicals: the neon arrow and yellow windows light the scene, and the building falls off into dark shadow away from them. Both cards' numbers sit inside the real range, so this rests on the eye.
pairs.fix: Light the tower from the upper left. Keep the left of the dome and wall bright and let the right third fall into a cool blue-grey shadow, with a dark line under the blue roof band. No glow around the dome.

pairs.difference: A: the bottle body is a soft even glow with no core shadow, only a slight darkening at the base and right edge, and no cast shadow. Its shading range (0.459) is below every real card. B: the goal has lit top faces, darker inner faces and a soft shadow under the ball, with light falling clearly from the upper left.
pairs.fix: Light the bottle from the upper left. Run a dark blue shadow down its right side and under the shoulder, and add one long thin highlight along the left edge.

pairs.difference: A: the flowers and bricks are lit from above with small glossy highlights on the brick tops and soft contact shadow under the bed. B: the books have a soft window light with dark shadow lines between them and a darker room behind. The book stack's range (0.878) is above the real cards, but that comes partly from the dark room. Neither card breaks the lessons clearly on light.

A: the cream cabinet's side panel is only slightly darker than the front, the front is flat and evenly lit, and the lens stays warm cream with a gentle turn at the corner. B: the monitor's side drops hard into a deep blue shadow against a pale front, with a crisp corner, the same treatment as the real computer in the lessons.
pairs.fix: Make the right side of the cabinet much darker, a deep cool blue-grey, with a sharp change at the front corner. Let the front fade slightly from top left to bottom right.

pairs.difference: A: the binocular barrels turn from pale tops to dark undersides and sit in a deep soft shadow on the floor, though the range (0.925) runs slightly above the real cards. B: the arm's segments are evenly lit with little core shadow, while its cast shadow is a thin, crisp, separate shape on the tiles that does not match the soft shadow pools on the real cards.
pairs.fix: Make the arm's cast shadow soft and blurred at the edges and darkest near the base. Let the undersides of the arm segments fall into a darker cool shadow.

pairs.difference: A: the car body is blown pale along the top and drops to a dull grey band low on the side, the dome is a broad milky sheen, and the shadow side reads neutral to brown in the lens. B: the scarf has soft cloth folds with a dark inner collar, but its form contrast (0.256) is below the real cards, so this call is weak.
pairs.fix: Keep the car's top bright without washing out the colour. Turn the lower side into a deeper cool teal shadow, with a clear shadow edge along the body, and shrink the dome highlight to one small curved shine.

pairs.difference: A: the tray has clear directional light, with bright top faces, darker cell sides and a shadow falling onto the wood (bias 0.63). B: the phone is lit almost head-on, its body and handset staying the same pale tone in the lens like soft clay, with light bias (0.086) below every real card. Only the floor shadow gives direction.
pairs.fix: Light the phone from the upper left. Let the right side of the body and the underside of the handset fall into a deep cool green shadow, with a crisp change at the body's corner.

pairs.difference: A: the plane's fuselage turns smoothly from a bright top to a dark blue-grey belly, with a clear core shadow along its length. B: the satellite's faces are mostly flat and evenly lit, with a pale halo around the body in the lens, tiny hot spots on the rivets, and a dark band only at the very bottom.
pairs.fix: Light the satellite from the upper left, with the top face brightest, the right face in deep shadow and a gradual fade across the front. Remove the glow around the body and soften the rivet highlights.

pairs.difference: A: the shoes are lit almost head-on, with a very low light bias (0.019) and a range (0.82) above the real cards, and a hard, dark cast shadow sits under them, so the uppers read as a flat, even surface. B: the flask has a soft cast shadow with a green glow in it, but its range (0.565) is also below the real cards, so the call is weak.
pairs.fix: Light the shoes from one side, darken the far side of each shoe into a soft cool shadow, and soften the floor shadow's edge so it is darkest only where the sole touches.

pairs.difference: A: the tube's glass and cap are evenly toned, the lens shows a flat grey column with little turn from light to shadow, and the range (0.549) is below the real cards. B: the pier has warm low sun with lit plank tops, darker plank sides, deep shadow on the posts below the deck and a clear dark side on the life ring.
pairs.fix: Light the cap and base from one side, with one side of the cap dropping into dark shadow. Add a bright thin highlight on the glass and a dark edge on the opposite side so the tube reads round.

pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away through frontal, even light. The hero's shadow side stays shallow, so forms read as soft clay or plastic rather than turning into a deep cool shadow with a crisp corner. Lens tones stay warm or neutral where real cards go blue in the shadows, and several generated cards carry a pale glow around the hero in place of a defined shadow side. Cast shadows are either missing or crisp, thin shapes rather than soft pools anchored at the contact point.
